name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Technical Implementation | Marketing Data Onboarding, Integrations & Output QA
summary: Client-facing implementation lead with 15+ years in MarTech, SaaS, and agency roles, grounded in marketing and media data. Connects and validates marketing data hands-on: GA4 and Google Tag Manager implementations, SQL against BigQuery and GA4 exports, Power BI data models, and API integrations with Python and JavaScript code steps in Zapier, Make, and n8n. Reconciles ad-platform reporting (Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn) against CRM and conversion data to find where the numbers break. Ran 25+ onboardings a month at Wix at 110% of implementation targets and scoped CRM implementations at Accelo, explaining to clients what the system actually needs from their data and why. Uses agentic AI daily to automate repeatable steps.

Build API integrations in Zapier, Make, and n8n with custom Python and JavaScript code steps to map, transform, and move data between CRMs, ad platforms, and reporting tools.

Turn repeated work into reusable templates, workflows, and rubric-based QA checks, applying agentic AI to automate manual, error-prone steps.
